s27-ndima-n-enkumbi.text: I dig with a hoe in the morning.
alts: I dig with the hoe in the morning.
I farm with a hoe in the morning.

s27-okusiga-ensigo.text: We plant seeds in the rainy season.
alts: We sow seeds in the rainy season.
The coffee of Buganda is very good.

s27-okukungula.text: Tomorrow we will harvest the groundnuts.
alts: We will harvest the groundnuts tomorrow.

s27-ndimira-jjajja.text: I dig the garden for grandparent.
alts: I dig the banana garden for grandma.
I dig the garden for my grandparent.
I dig the garden for grandpa.

s27-nfumbira-abaana.text: I cook food for the children.

s27-ntundira-mu-katale.text: I sell coffee at the market.
alts: I sell the coffee at the market.

s27-mpandiikira-maama.text: I write a message to mother.
alts: I write a message to my mother.
